metadata.document_title: Design elements - PowerPoint - Bosch Brand Guide

page.title: Design elements
page.core_principle: All slides are composed of several design elements. A recurring typeface, uniform design language, and consistent image and illustration style ensure a clear, CD-compliant appearance and help structure complex information in an appealing way.

design_elements.name: Colors and color combinations
design_elements.purpose: Create consistent, CD-compliant visual structure across PowerPoint slides and chapters.
rules: Use only the colors specified in the PowerPoint Design Kit.
Bosch Red is reserved for the logotype and may only be used very sparingly for accentuation.
One of the four Bosch accent colors should run throughout each presentation.
If a presentation contains several chapters and colored structuring is suitable, a separate accent color can be used for each chapter.
For longer presentations requiring more than four chapter colors, Bosch Gray 50 can be used as a fifth color.
For presentations with more chapters, dark gradations should be added directly after the respective Bosch accent color.
For diagrams, use the accent color and its shade first. If these are not sufficient, add further brand colors from the PowerPoint Design Kit.
Ensure clear contrasts and good legibility, especially in diagrams and complex visual structures.
For complex diagrams, use the Bosch Diagrams color scheme, which is designed for contrast, readability, and accessibility.
extended_chapter_colors: Dark gradations of Bosch accent colors

diagram_color_guidance.primary_approach: Use the presentation accent color and its shade or gradation alternately to distinguish elements.
diagram_color_guidance.secondary_approach: Add additional brand colors from the PowerPoint Design Kit if the accent color and shade are insufficient.
diagram_color_guidance.accessibility_approach: Use the fixed Bosch Diagrams color scheme for complex diagrams because it supports contrast and readability.

ai_usage_notes: When generating a Bosch PowerPoint deck, define one global accent color unless chapter-based color coding is required.
Avoid red for general emphasis because Bosch Red is primarily reserved for the logotype.
Prefer high-contrast combinations and use Bosch Diagrams colors for data-dense charts.

design_elements.name: Images and illustrations
design_elements.purpose: Support a generous, structured, and brand-compliant presentation style through appropriate visual material.
rules: Use images and rather complex illustrations for full-screen slides to make the presentation look generous.
Use images and illustrations from the PowerPoint Design Kit, especially the Graphic Elements section.
Additional image material can be sourced from MAM, Bosch's central media asset management system.
Additional image material can also be sourced through Bosch accounts for GettyImages and Depositphotos.
Use Bosch image database guidance when sourcing further image material.
recommended_sources: PowerPoint Design Kit - Graphic Elements section
MAM - central media asset management system
ai_usage_notes: For image-heavy slides, prefer full-screen layouts rather than small decorative images.
Use complex illustrations mainly where they can occupy enough space and support comprehension rather than decoration.

design_elements.name: Icons
design_elements.purpose: Provide quick, consistent symbolic support for messages and structures in PowerPoint slides.
rules: The easiest way to search and place icons is with the Design Kit.
Icons can be searched and placed directly in PowerPoint via the Design Kit.
The Icon Library can be used as an additional option for Mac users, external agencies, or offline applications if access to eForms NG is not available.

placement_methods.recommended_for: Direct search and placement in PowerPoint
Mac users, external agencies, offline applications, or cases without eForms NG access

ai_usage_notes: Use icons as functional signposts, not decorative fillers.
Prefer library-compliant icons rather than improvised or mixed-style icon sets.

design_elements.name: Typography
design_elements.purpose: Maintain consistent text rendering and brand typography across Bosch PowerPoint documents.
rules: Bosch Office Sans is used by default in Office applications.
Bosch Office Sans is automatically installed as the system font on all Bosch computers.
Bosch Office Sans is preset as the default font in PowerPoint templates under eForms.
For correct display on external systems, Bosch Office Sans must be installed separately.

default_font.name: Bosch Office Sans
default_font.context: Office applications and PowerPoint templates under eForms

installation.external_systems: Must be installed separately for correct display

ai_usage_notes: When generating presentation specifications, set Bosch Office Sans as the default typeface.
If the file will be shared externally, flag font installation or fallback handling as a compatibility requirement.

design_elements.name: Shapes
design_elements.purpose: Use simple and minimalist graphic elements that align with Bosch design principles.
rules: Use a simple rectangle as the main shape.
Other preferred basic geometric shapes are square, circle, and triangle.
Create shapes and elements only in colors available in eForms NG.
Do not use effects such as shadows.
Use PowerPoint standard shapes that conform to minimalist and stripped-down design principles whenever possible.

dos.guidance: Use clear shapes, symmetrical if possible.

ai_usage_notes: Use rectangles for most containers, cards, highlight blocks, and layout divisions.
Avoid drop shadows, bevels, glow effects, and decorative irregular shapes.

design_elements.name: Diagrams
design_elements.purpose: Align PowerPoint diagrams and charts with Bosch data visualization principles as far as PowerPoint allows.
rules: Base diagrams and charts as closely as possible on the principles from the data visualization style guide.
Use the presentation accent color throughout the deck and in diagrams.
Use the accent color and its given shade or gradation alternately to distinguish elements.
For complex diagrams, use the Bosch Diagrams color scheme for accessibility, contrast, and readability.
ai_usage_notes: When generating charts, use accent color plus shade first before introducing additional colors.
Reserve multi-color palettes for complex categorical distinctions where contrast and readability require them.

global_ai_design_rules: Maintain a consistent typeface across the presentation.
Use a uniform design language across all slides.
Keep image and illustration style consistent.
Use design elements to structure complex information clearly and appealingly.
Avoid unnecessary effects such as shadows.
Ensure contrast and legibility in color combinations and diagrams.
Use Bosch-approved resources and kits as the primary source of visual elements.
